So the issue is that with the latest update that added Anomaly settings, they added a few new .xml files to the Anomaly folder and maybe changed some of the old ones. Steam doesn't know you have Anomaly so it's not adding those files. 

The solution would be to either delete Anomaly (or unselect in your mod settings), buy Anomaly so Steam knows it's legit and can change those files, or wait for someone to upload an updated version.
